lines.text: Why can't I move this stupid bench?
Want a hand?
No. I built it myself. I'll move it myself.
Where are we moving it?
Outside. Best spot in the garden. Before sunset.
Stay.
I don't think doors learn commands.
This one will. We've spent enough time together.
You've run out of arms.
I've still got a perfectly good chin.
Please keep that attached.
I wanted you to see something I'd done all by myself.
We saw. It's a lovely bench.
It looks less impressive stuck in a doorway.
Only the moving part is stuck.
Feels like the whole thing.
You didn't even think about asking.
I had full hands. She had a free one.
Berry, the door? Cherry, the other end?
Ready when you are.
Together. Lift.
Still your bench.
Better with people on it.
